sections.text_helper: Section 8.10.10 "PWR privilege configuration register (PWR_PRIVCFGR)" in chapter 8 (Power control (PWR)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 249.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x104
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register can be written only when the access is privileged. It can be read by privileged
or unprivileged access.
Bits 31:2 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 1 PRIV: PWR functions privilege configuration
Set and reset by software. This bit can be written only by privileged access.
0: Read and write to PWR functions can be done by privileged or unprivileged access.
1: Read and write to PWR functions can be done by privileged access only.
Bit 0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
